svg.title: Own-baseline color-evidence centroid movement
svg.desc: Arrows from the origin show color-evidence centroid movement from each platform own unchanged source baseline. Native black, r1 dashed gray, r2 region color. Screen y increases down.

g.text: Primary threshold 8; +x right, +y down. Origin is each platform own unchanged source baseline.
Native black; r1 dashed gray; r2 source-region color. Vectors do not recover optical rays.
Each cell spans -4..+4 world units in both axes. Full four-threshold vectors: baseline-transport-summary.json.
